SOURCE_CHAIN_DOWNGRADE.finding: Prior loop-dynamics lowering fixtures do not establish end-to-end ClayCode compiler semantic preservation because representative source was not admitted by the current grammar and lowering introduced an unproven emit-as-return termination behavior. A 20000-case discriminator differed in 17693 cases between terminating-return and nonterminating-emit semantics.
SOURCE_CHAIN_DOWNGRADE.fusion_effect: Preserve prior loop-dynamics results only as controlled dynamics/mechanism fixtures. Supersede any interpretation that treated them as source->parse->IR->lowering compiler-chain evidence.
SOURCE_CHAIN_DOWNGRADE.new_gate: BASE evidence must carry one content-addressed unbroken chain: admitted source -> production parse -> canonical typed IR -> type/effect/flow check -> checked lowering -> executable target -> replay receipt.

SECOND_GENERATION_HYPOTHESES.finding: New transformed hypotheses remain hypothesis generation, not replication or promotion.
